other_probes: PWM CH0..5 may retain their existing correct mapping; no additional channels required for endpoint comparison
usb: Saleae to PC only after physical J1 removal and meter-confirmed discharge; MCU USB not required
operator_action_during_capture: Enable only J4 15V after capture-start confirmation; J1 remains physically unplugged.
interpretation: Compare LOW start/end times on TP23 and PA6 at 41.7-ns sample spacing; no digital glitch filter.
A LOW only on PA6 points to the interconnect/measurement/reference path; swap probes to check instrument influence before assigning cause.
A shared LOW shows propagation to both endpoints, but does not uniquely prove intrinsic IPM overcurrent/UVLO.
No auxiliary-only event cannot clear or reproduce the powered 22-Hz failure by itself.
CIN/15V/phase/DC-bus are not direct inputs for this digital-only measurement.
USB unplugging from PC, a floating laptop or an unverified USB isolator is not an accepted isolation plan for HV.
